detail: DELETE TEST TC-EPIC-359-02: Every brand card's product count equals the item count of the catalog it opens: The 13-brand loop repeats the count and header checks with different literals but identifies no additional behavior or branch. Remove this case; TC-EPIC-359-01 and TC-EPIC-359-03 already exercise the count hand-off in the required journeys.

AC1 requires the catalog to show only the selected brand's items. The URL, active filter, header and toolbar count can all be correct while unrelated products render. Add an assertion comparing the rendered product identities with the seeded Daybird product set, traversing pagination if necessary.

After step 3 (reload) the case expects 'Most products' to still be the selected sort option. The test asserts aria-current after the reload, but the keyframe for that highlight (08 'After reload: Most products selected') and every other post-reload frame (09-13) show only the card grid, scrolled down with the Sort control above the viewport. The only frame showing 'Most products' selected (03) is from before the reload. Bring the Sort control into view after page.reload() (for example scroll to top or scrollIntoViewIfNeeded) before the highlight, so the recording proves the selection survived the reload. [raised by opus, sol]
